history.historicalImportance: Jehanabad has historical significance as part of the ancient Magadha region and has been associated with the Maurya and Gupta empires. It is known for several archaeological and historical sites.
history.formationHistory: Jehanabad was carved out of the erstwhile Gaya district and became an independent district on 1 August 1986.
history.freedomMovement: The district actively participated in the Indian freedom movement through the Non-Cooperation Movement, Civil Disobedience Movement and Quit India Movement.
history.archaeologicalImportance: The district contains several ancient temples, inscriptions and archaeological remains reflecting the heritage of Magadha.
historicalTimeLine: Ancient Period – Part of the Magadha Kingdom
3rd Century BCE – Flourished under the Maurya Empire
Gupta Period – Continued as an important administrative region
1 August 1986 – Jehanabad became a separate district
Present – Developing district of Magadh Division

geography.location: Jehanabad district is located in the southern part of Bihar and is a part of the Magadh Division.
geography.climate: Subtropical climate with hot summers, moderate monsoon and cool winters
geography.forests: Limited forest cover, mainly scattered reserve forest areas

agriculture.dairyDevelopment: Dairy farming is an important supplementary source of income for rural households.
agriculture.fisheries: Fish farming is practiced in ponds and other inland water bodies.

infrastructure.roadNetwork: Jehanabad has a well-connected road network linking all blocks with nearby districts.
infrastructure.airConnectivity: Jay Prakash Narayan International Airport, Patna (about 60 km)
infrastructure.publicTransport: Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC), private buses, taxis and auto-rickshaws.
infrastructure.electricity: Most urban and rural areas have electricity connectivity under state and central rural electrification schemes.
infrastructure.waterSupply: Urban areas receive piped water supply, while rural areas depend on hand pumps and rural water supply schemes.
infrastructure.internetConnectivity: 4G and 5G mobile services are available in most parts of the district.

education.governmentSchools: More than 1,000 government schools operate across the district.
education.privateSchools: Several CBSE, ICSE and Bihar Board affiliated private schools are located in Jehanabad.

healthcare.primaryHealthCentres: Primary Health Centres (PHCs) function across all blocks of the district.
healthcare.ambulanceServices: 102 and 108 ambulance services are available throughout the district.

cultureAndHeritage.traditionalDress: Men traditionally wear Dhoti-Kurta, while women wear Saree and Salwar-Kameez.
culturalOrganizations: District Art and Culture Office, Jehanabad
Bihar Department of Art, Culture and Youth

sportsAcademies: Bihar State Sports Authority Training Centre
sportsAchievements: District athletes regularly participate in state-level competitions.
School and college teams represent Jehanabad in inter-district tournaments.
Growing participation in cricket, football and athletics.

bankingAndFinance.atms: ATMs of major public sector and private banks are available across the district.
bankingAndFinance.digitalBanking: UPI, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking and Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS) services are widely available.

governanceAndPublicServices.districtAdministration: Jehanabad district is administered by the District Magistrate (DM) with support from various district-level departments.
governanceAndPublicServices.policeAdministration: Law and order is maintained by Jehanabad Police under the Bihar Police.
governanceAndPublicServices.fireServices: Fire stations operate in Jehanabad town and other strategic locations of the district.
governanceAndPublicServices.publicDistributionSystem: Essential commodities are distributed through Fair Price Shops under the Public Distribution System (PDS).
eGovernanceServices: Bihar Right to Public Services Portal

lawAndOrder.trafficPolice: Traffic Police regulate traffic and enforce road safety across the district.
lawAndOrder.disasterManagement: The District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA), Jehanabad coordinates disaster preparedness, flood management, drought response and emergency relief operations.

environment.forestCover: Forest cover is limited, mainly concentrated in parts of Kako and Hulasganj blocks.

mediaAndCommunication.postalServices: India Post provides postal and parcel services through post offices across Jehanabad district.
mediaAndCommunication.telecommunication: 4G and 5G mobile connectivity is available in most parts of the district.
